description: Create the ordinary onboarding trigger marker so the authorized protected workflow executes npm run toolchain:onboard on a GitHub-hosted checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Create dev_scripts/toolchain-onboarding-request.json as a non-production trigger marker.
The marker contains a unique request id and states that the full onboarding drill is required.
No production or runtime source is changed.
raw_operations_reason: This is a one-file non-runtime trigger marker whose only purpose is to activate the already-authorized remote onboarding workflow; no semantic source authoring is required.
